user.title: DiPlus-to-hass
user.description: Enter the car name exactly as it is set in the DiPlus-to-hass Android app (Settings → Car name). The app signs every data payload with this name, so it must match letter for letter.

data_description.car_name: Letters, digits, underscore and dash only (no spaces), up to 64 characters

abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this name is already configured
